versions.content: In contrast to the SHUTDOWN phase, the ECU Manager mod- ule shall not shut down the OS when entering the SLEEP phase. The sleep mode, i.e. combination of the EcuM SLEEP phase and the Mcu Mode, shall be transparent to the OS.
